| `0x1000C001` | 热床温度较高，可能造成耗材软化堵头。您可打开机箱门打印。 | High bed temperature may lead to filament clogging in the nozzle. You may open the chamber door. |
| `0x1000C002` | 用不锈钢喷嘴打印碳纤维料可能造成喷嘴损坏。 | Printing CF material with stainless steel may cause nozzle damage. |
| `0x1000C003` | 开启传统模式的延时摄影，可能会产生表面瑕疵，请根据需要启用。 | Enabling Timelapse in traditional mode may cause defects; please activate this feature as needed. |
| `0x10014001` | 切片参数中开启了旋转花瓶，无法支持延时摄影。 | Timelapse is not supported as Spiral Vase mode is enabled in slicing presets. |
| `0x10014002` | 切片参数中开启了逐件打印，无法支持延时摄影。 | Timelapse is not supported as the Print sequence is set to "By object". |
| `0x10018003` | 当前切片中的延时摄影为传统模式，开启延时摄影后可能会产生表面瑕疵，请确认是否开启？ | The time-lapse mode is set to Traditional in the slicing file. This may cause surface defects. Would you like to enable it? |
